clips.title: The story
paras: Northshire Abbey trains new defenders in Northshire Valley, among Elwynn Forest's northern foothills. Rebuilt after the First War, it is the spiritual heart of the Brotherhood of Northshire and a leading school for those answering Stormwind's call.

Clerics from Lordaeron came south centuries ago to spread the Holy Light and founded the Holy Order of Northshire Clerics and their abbey. The monastery soon became part of kingdom life, caring for the sick and tending to the young Guardian Medivh during his years in a coma. In the First War, brigands and the Orcish Horde attacked it repeatedly, and the abbey was destroyed. After the Alliance of Lordaeron liberated the region in the Second War, Archbishop Alonsus Faol helped rebuild the sanctuary and refounded its protectors as the Brotherhood of Northshire.

Northshire Abbey trains volunteers, militia recruits, and novices who hope to defend Stormwind. Its Main Hall, Hall of Arms, and Library Wing house instructors in martial, arcane, and holy arts, while scouts and rogues train in the outer yards. The Knights of the Silver Hand keep watch, but peace remains fragile. Kobolds overrun nearby mines, aggressive wolves prowl the orchards, and Defias Brotherhood agents stalk the valley roads. They steal ancient scrolls and sacred librams from the abbey's archives.
